name: Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya
summary: Public technical university in Barcelona; four bachelor's taught in English, from civil engineering and bioinformatics to video game design.

ib.text: IB via UNEDasiss (grade 5–10), then Catalonia's pre-enrolment. Only PAU specific-phase or UNED PCE exams lift it towards 14; IB subject grades on the credential do not count.

programmes.name: Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering
programmes.about: Civil engineering at the Barcelona School of Civil Engineering, from infrastructure and water to logistics, the circular economy and climate change, with a group taught 100% in English.
programmes.ib: Choose the group taught 100% in English; other groups use Catalan or Spanish.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14 in the Catalan pre-enrolment; the cut-off is for the whole degree, all groups.

programmes.name: Bachelor's degree in Bioinformatics (interuniversity UPC-UB-UAB-UPF degree)
programmes.about: Computing and biology combined for advances in medicine, agriculture and food, taught entirely in English and coordinated by UPC's School of Informatics with UAB, UB and UPF.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14 in the Catalan pre-enrolment (code 91917); 50 places.

programmes.name: Bachelor's degree in Industrial Technologies and Economic Analysis (interuniversity UPC-UPF degree)
programmes.about: Industrial engineering with economics, taught entirely in English by UPC and UPF, with a sequential path into UPC's master's in Industrial Engineering.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14 in the Catalan pre-enrolment (code 91915); 50 places.

programmes.name: Bachelor's degree in Video Game Design and Development (taught in English)
programmes.about: Video game design and programming, with content and teaching 100% in English at UPC's Image Processing and Multimedia Technology Centre (CITM) in Barcelona.
programmes.ib: Taught at CITM, a UPC centre with its own fee (€6,900 a year).
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked in the Catalan pre-enrolment (code 31083); the 2026-27 admission mark was 5.000, the lowest possible access grade. 30 places.

notes: Industrial Technologies and Economic Analysis is a joint UPC–UPF degree and appears on both universities' pages.
Video Game Design and Development is taught at the CITM centre and costs €6,900 a year, well above the public fee of about €1,061.
